name: What are common signs of a hidden pipe leak in my home?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a hidden pipe leak in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hidden pipe leaks can often go unnoticed until significant damage occurs. Common indicators include unexplained spikes in your water bill, damp or discolored spots on walls, ceilings, or floors, a persistent musty odor, and the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use. You might also notice a drop in water pressure or warm spots on your floor, which could indicate a slab leak. Regular inspection of visible pipes and monitoring your water meter can help catch issues early.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for unexplained water bill increases, damp spots, musty smells, or the sound of running water. A drop in water pressure or warm floor spots can also indicate a leak.
